```{python}
from dataclasses import replace

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    coord_flip,
    element_text,
    geom_col,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_fill_manual,
    theme,
    theme_minimal,
)
from scipy import stats
from tableone import TableOne

from caching import run_regression_with_caching
from dictionary import VARIABLE_LABELS
from render import make_shock_regression_table, make_regression_table
from specs import (
    analysis_df,
    jobloss,
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    temperature_spec,
    update_formula_search_replace,
    MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE,
)

temperature_spec = temperature_spec
main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock, jobloss]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]
shock_groups = [
    "palm_farmer_hh_ifls4",
    "urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    "coal_worker_hh_ifls4",
    "job_loss_1_yr",
]
shock_posts = ["ifls5", "post_subsidy", "ifls5", None]

shock_groups_panel = shock_groups[:-1]
shock_posts_panel = shock_posts[:-1]
```

# Descriptives

## Temperature Balance


```{python}
balance_variables = [
    "age",
    "female",
    "edu_yrs",
    "married",
    "widowed",
    "palm_farmer_hh_ifls4",
    "palm_shock_exposed",
    "urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    "fuel_shock_exposed",
    "job_loss_1_yr",
    "job_loss_ifls5",
]
balance_labels = {
    **VARIABLE_LABELS,
    "palm_shock_exposed": "Palm farmer x IFLS5",
    "fuel_shock_exposed": "Urban vehicle owner x post subsidy",
    "job_loss_ifls5": "Job loss x IFLS5",
}


def welch_ttest(*groups):
    return stats.ttest_ind(
        groups[0],
        groups[1],
        equal_var=False,
        nan_policy="omit",
    ).pvalue


def make_temperature_balance_data(df, *, temperature):
    out = df.copy()
    out["ifls5"] = out["wave"] == "IFLS5"
    out["palm_shock_exposed"] = (
        out["palm_farmer_hh_ifls4"].astype("Int64") * out["ifls5"]
    )
    out["fuel_shock_exposed"] = (
        out["urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4"].astype("Int64") * out["post_subsidy"]
    )
    out["job_loss_ifls5"] = out["job_loss_1_yr"] * out["ifls5"]

    median = out[temperature].median()
    out["temperature_median_split"] = pd.NA
    out.loc[out[temperature] < median, "temperature_median_split"] = "Low"
    out.loc[out[temperature] > median, "temperature_median_split"] = "High"

    low_cutoff = out[temperature].quantile(0.25)
    high_cutoff = out[temperature].quantile(0.75)
    out["temperature_high_low_quartile"] = pd.NA
    out.loc[out[temperature] <= low_cutoff, "temperature_high_low_quartile"] = "Low"
    out.loc[out[temperature] >= high_cutoff, "temperature_high_low_quartile"] = "High"

    return out


def make_balance_table(data, group):
    return TableOne(
        data.dropna(subset=[group]),
        columns=balance_variables,
        continuous=balance_variables,
        categorical=[],
        groupby=group,
        pval=True,
        overall=False,
        htest={variable: welch_ttest for variable in balance_variables},
        htest_name=False,
        rename=balance_labels,
        decimals=3,
        pval_digits=3,
    )


balance_data = make_temperature_balance_data(
    analysis_df,
    temperature=MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE,
)
```

# Robustness

## Job Loss 

```{python}
jobloss_windows = [
    ("3 mo", "job_loss_90d"),
    ("6 mo", "job_loss_180d"),
    ("9 mo", "job_loss_270d"),
    ("1 yr", "job_loss_1_yr"),
    ("18 mo", "job_loss_540d"),
    ("2 yr", "job_loss_730d"),
    ("36 mo", "job_loss_1095d"),
    ("5 yr", "job_loss_1825d"),
]
jobloss_robustness_specs = [
    update_formula_search_replace(jobloss, "job_loss_1_yr", job_loss_var)
    for _, job_loss_var in jobloss_windows
]
rename_dict = {job_loss_var: f"Job Loss" for label, job_loss_var in jobloss_windows}
# Append
rename_dict[MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE] = "Heat"
make_regression_table(
    jobloss_robustness_specs,
    rename=rename_dict,
    keep=["Job Loss", "Heat", "Job Loss:Heat"],
    titles=[f"{label}" for label, _ in jobloss_windows],
)
```

## Fuel Cut Placebo Dates

```{python}
fuel_placebo_rng = np.random.default_rng(20260610)
fuel_placebo_df = analysis_df[analysis_df["wave"] == "IFLS5"].copy()
fuel_placebo_df["interview_date"] = pd.to_datetime(
    fuel_placebo_df["interview_datetime"]
).dt.normalize()

fuel_placebo_dates = sorted(
    pd.Timestamp(date)
    for date in fuel_placebo_rng.choice(
        pd.date_range(
            fuel_placebo_df["interview_date"].min() + pd.Timedelta(days=1),
            fuel_placebo_df["interview_date"].max() - pd.Timedelta(days=1),
            freq="D",
        ).to_numpy(),
        size=10,
        replace=False,
    )
)
fuel_cutoff_dates = [pd.Timestamp("2014-11-18"), *fuel_placebo_dates]
fuel_cutoff_posts = [
    "post_subsidy",
    *[f"post_{cutoff_date:%Y%m%d}" for cutoff_date in fuel_placebo_dates],
]

for cutoff_date, post_var in zip(fuel_placebo_dates, fuel_cutoff_posts[1:], strict=True):
    fuel_placebo_df[post_var] = (
        fuel_placebo_df["interview_date"] >= cutoff_date
    ).astype(int)

fuel_cutoff_specs = [replace(fuel_shock, df=fuel_placebo_df, title="2014-11-18")]
for cutoff_date, post_var in zip(fuel_placebo_dates, fuel_cutoff_posts[1:], strict=True):
    cutoff_spec = update_formula_search_replace(fuel_shock, "post_subsidy", post_var)
    fuel_cutoff_specs.append(
        replace(cutoff_spec, df=fuel_placebo_df, title=cutoff_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
    )

make_shock_regression_table(
    fuel_cutoff_specs,
    group="urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    post=fuel_cutoff_posts,
    temperature=MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE,
)
```

## Fuel Cut Expenditure Placebos

```{python}
def fuel_expenditure_spec(spec, post_var):
    expenditure_spec = update_formula_search_replace(spec, "cesd_z", "pce_log")
    formula = expenditure_spec.formula.replace(f" * {MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE}", "")
    term = f"urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4:{post_var}"
    return replace(expenditure_spec, formula=formula, show_terms=frozenset([term]))


fuel_expenditure_specs = [
    fuel_expenditure_spec(spec, post_var)
    for spec, post_var in zip(fuel_cutoff_specs, fuel_cutoff_posts, strict=True)
]
fuel_expenditure_rows = []
for spec, post_var, cutoff_date in zip(
    fuel_expenditure_specs,
    fuel_cutoff_posts,
    fuel_cutoff_dates,
    strict=True,
):
    coef_table = run_regression_with_caching(spec).coef_table
    term = f"urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4:{post_var}"
    fuel_expenditure_rows.append(
        {
            "date": cutoff_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "coefficient": coef_table.loc[term, "b"],
            "cutoff": "True post date" if post_var == "post_subsidy" else "Placebo date",
        }
    )

fuel_expenditure_coefs = pd.DataFrame(fuel_expenditure_rows).sort_values(
    "coefficient",
    key=lambda values: values.abs(),
)
fuel_expenditure_coefs["date"] = pd.Categorical(
    fuel_expenditure_coefs["date"],
    categories=fuel_expenditure_coefs["date"],
    ordered=True,
)

(
    ggplot(fuel_expenditure_coefs, aes(x="date", y="coefficient", fill="cutoff"))
    + geom_col()
    + coord_flip()
    + scale_fill_manual(
        values={"True post date": "#1b9e77", "Placebo date": "#7570b3"}
    )
    + labs(
        x="Cutoff date",
        y="Urban vehicle household x post cutoff coefficient",
        fill="Cutoff",
    )
    + theme_minimal()
    + theme(axis_text_y=element_text(size=8))
)
```
